text:
Alyssa: heads up — got paged by incident-bot for INF-GW-5xx-rate on prod-us. seeing a ~10% 5xx rate and tail latency up. I'm starting an initial triage but might need a handoff in ~30m if this doesn't stabilize. tagging SREs :wave:
incident-bot: ALERT INF-GW-5xx-rate triggered at 2026-03-15T09:12:01Z; severity=P2; threshold=5% 5xx over 5m; affected=prod-us inference-gateway
Michael: oncall here, jumping in. running `curl http://prod-us-kibana/query?service=inference-gateway` to pull recent stack traces. any deploys in the last hour?
Alyssa: no deploys recorded in the last 2h. quick grep shows repeated `upstream response: 503` from pool lmq-02. CPU on nodes in that pool is spiking to 98% right before failures.
Sam: could be an autoscaler misconfig or a model-hotspot. I'm checking recent routing changes from the model-router team.
Nirmal: i'll open a temporary alert squelch in alertmanager for 30m to reduce noise while we triage. propose raising firing threshold from 5% -> 8% for INF-GW-5xx-rate while we stabilize + add a new dashboard chart for per-pool 5xx.
Michael: +1 for squelch. also let's add an annotation to the runbook so future oncalls know we tried a dialdown first.
Alyssa: agree. quick mitigation: draining lmq-02 nodes one at a time to prevent OOM cascade. doing drain on node lmq-02-a now.
Michael: logs show a memory leak in model-server v2.3.4 - pinned to process that spills over at high concurrency. workaround: reduce `max_concurrency` on the model-router route for v2 models from 16 -> 8. Sam, can you push that change?
Sam: yes patching route now. patch is small:```yaml
# model-router routing patch
routes:
  - model: v2
    max_concurrency: 8
```
Sam: pushed, will monitor heatmap.
incident-bot: NOTE: alert INF-GW-5xx-rate suppressed via silence id=sl-1768254321 for 30m by Nirmal
Nirmal: created dashboard tile: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/inf-gw/5xx-by-pool (ops only). added per-pool 5xx and per-node CPU.
Michael: after the patch and drains, 5xx dropped to ~1.2% and latency normalized. can we mark this as mitigated?
Alyssa: mitigation looks good from my side. marking for handoff: Michael will own postmortem and runbook edits, Alyssa will write initial notes, Nirmal will add dashboard + alert changes, Sam will follow up on model-server memory leak ticket.
Alyssa: Follow-up items (quick):
- Create postmortem doc and link to incident page
- Update INF-GW runbook with a `Dialdown & Throttle` section describing `max_concurrency` change and steps to drain lmq pools
- Annotate runbook with the alert tuning decision and provide the silence id
- Add owner tags and a playbook snippet for `if 5xx > 8% and CPU > 90% on pool -> drain nodes one-by-one`
Michael: I'll own the runbook edits. Alyssa, can you drop the concrete text you want added? I can paste and push to the runbooks repo.
Alyssa: will do. here's a minimal runbook patch to add under "Mitigation steps":
```markdown
- If INF-GW-5xx-rate fires and is confirmed to be pool-local: 
  1. Check per-pool CPU and 5xx: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/inf-gw/5xx-by-pool
  2. If CPU > 90% on a single pool, drain nodes in that pool one at a time:
     - kubectl cordon <node>
     - kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
  3. Reduce model-router `max_concurrency` for the affected model version to reduce memory pressure.
  4. If still failing, engage model infra: @Sam
  5. Record actions in incident page and add `alert-manager silence id` to runbook annotations.
```
Sam: small note — add step to check recent model uploads/weight changes; model-server v2.3.4 has a known gradual leak under certain batch sizes. link to ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-1429
Nirmal: for alerting change, here's the prometheus rule we applied temporarily. please review for permanency:
```yaml
- alert: INF-GW-5xx-rate
  expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"inference-gateway\",code=~\"5..\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"inference-gateway\"}[5m])) > 0.08
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: \"5xx rate > 8% on inference-gateway (prod-us)\"
```
Michael: good. for permanence we should add a threshold rationale and link to SLOs before making 8% the default. I'll add a block in the runbook and link the SLO: https://redwood.internal/slo/inf-gw-errors
Alyssa: assigning owners explicitly: Michael -> runbook & postmortem (due 72h), Nirmal -> dashboard & alert change PR (due 24h), Sam -> follow kernel memory leak ticket and triage (due 48h).
Michael: I'll create the PR for runbook edits and include the silence id and the rule diff. tagging @oncall for visibility. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED at 2026-03-15T09:19:45Z; status=mitigated; incident_id=INC-20260315-001
Alyssa: thanks everyone. once runbook PR is up, add a short changelog entry in the runbook header with timestamp and owner. leaving handoff to Michael — I'm going offline for a brief break.
Michael: taking the handoff. will post links to the PRs and postmortem in this thread when ready.
Sam: noted, following up on ticket INF-1429.
Nirmal: dashboard/alert PR will target next-day patch window.
Alyssa: closing the thread here — feel free to continue updates inline. :lock:
